inputs.share_count_basis: Weighted-average diluted shares, Q3-2026 10-Q EPS note (157,502 thousand; nine-month figure 157,610). Held FLAT because SBC and equity-award withholding taxes are fully expensed in the flows; charging both would double-count.
inputs.cash_note: Cash 460.7 + short-term marketable securities 5.8 + long-term marketable securities 158.3 = 624.9 (Q3-2026 10-Q liquidity table). Revolver fully repaid during 9M-2026 (350 drawn, 550 repaid); the new $1.0B 2026 Credit Facility was undrawn at quarter-end.
inputs.sbc_source: TTM to Q3-2026. Cash-flow-statement SBC add-back 80.1 (FY2025 64.0 - 9M-2025 47.6 + 9M-2026 63.6) PLUS cash taxes paid on net-share settlement 42.6 (FY2025 15.7 - 9M-2025 15.3 + 9M-2026 42.2). Teradyne publishes no combined figure, so the two lines are summed. Equity-award taxes nearly tripled in 2026 because awards vested at a much higher share price.
inputs.fcf_basis_note: All FCF figures are TTM to Q3-2026 (27 Sep 2026): OCF 1,329.5 (FY2025 674.4 - 9M-2025 392.8 + 9M-2026 1,047.9) less capex 304.7 (224.0 - 161.1 + 241.8) = reported FCF 1,024.8. Owner FCF = 1,024.8 - 122.7 - 12.0 = 890.1. Net cash is below 1x the FCF base so the interest strip is not strictly required; it is applied anyway (12.0, immaterial) to keep the series consistent. TTM FCF is after a working-capital build of roughly 220 in 9M-2026 (inventories +179).
inputs.buyback_note: TTM financing-activity outflow (FY2025 702.1 - 9M-2025 518.7 + 9M-2026 173.5). Funded repurchaser: buybacks have exceeded SBC every year since 2015 and the diluted count has fallen from 213M (FY2015) to 157.5M, so the flat count is paid for rather than a modelling convention. 2026 pace slowed sharply (0.5M shares in nine months) as the price rose.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Risk-free ~4.3% (10-year UST) + equity beta ~1.3-1.4 x ERP ~4.5% = cost of equity ~10-10.5%; the company is debt-free so WACC = cost of equity, rounded to 10.0%. The same 10% is used in all three scenarios: cyclical and concentration risk is carried in the scenario paths and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: the lease charge is already inside operating expense and therefore inside EBITDA, so it is in the flows. Operating lease liabilities (137.1 at Q3-2026) are excluded from net debt. One treatment, not two.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (they include 100% of the MultiLane Test Products JV, 75% owned since April 2026). The 25% redeemable noncontrolling interest is deducted once in the equity bridge at its carrying/redemption value of 49.1.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route), 10-year horizon, three scenarios. Teradyne is an operating company (semiconductor ATE + robotics) so the default route applies; no financial/REIT variant. CYCLE FRAMING: FY2026E revenue of ~5.2B is 64% above FY2025 and ~40% above the prior peak (FY2021 3.7B) after a decade in which revenue compounded at ~7%. The model does NOT extrapolate the surge. FY0 is the peak-ish FY2026E base; the base case assumes a digestion dip in FY2028 and then a ~5% mid-cycle growth rate, landing FY2036 revenue at ~7.4B, i.e. ~8% CAGR off the pre-surge FY2025 level, with adjusted EBITDA margins normalising to ~33.5% from ~37.5% in 9M-2026. TIMING: FY0 = FY2026E, so year 1 is FY2027 and is discounted one full period from a mid-November 2026 valuation date; Q4-2026 cash generation (~250-300) is not in the 27 Sep balance sheet, which is a small conservatism (~$2/share). POST-BALANCE-SHEET: a $300M minority equity investment in FormFactor (signed 6 Oct 2026, expected to close Q4-2026) converts cash into a listed stake at cost; treated as value-neutral, no bridge item. EBITDA BASIS: the CSV EBITDA is GAAP (after the SBC expense). The engine's adjusted EBITDA is before SBC, so ebitda_margin_path = GAAP EBITDA margin + cash-flow SBC (~1.6pp), and sbc_pct_path charges SBC plus equity-award taxes (~2.5%). PRICE: regular Friday close, not an after-hours print; the stock is highly volatile (52-week range 151.52-487.91).

equity_bridge.item: Redeemable noncontrolling interest (25% of MultiLane Test Products JV)
equity_bridge.note: Q3-2026 10-Q balance sheet, carried at redemption value after 7.6 accretion

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (4.8%) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (0.4%) and EPS (-4.1%). All CAGRs are on completed fiscal years FY2020/FY2022 -> FY2025 and are cycle-distorted: FY2020-FY2022 were the prior peak and FY2025 predates most of the AI surge. The 10-year revenue CAGR (FY2015 1,640 -> FY2025 3,190) is 6.9% and is the better mid-cycle anchor; the scenario paths use that, not the 5-year figures.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - equity-award taxes - interest income): FY2020 610.1, FY2022 326.9, FY2025 355.0. Owner-FCF 5yr CAGR (-10.3%) is below reported (-8.0%) because SBC plus award taxes rose from 68 to 80 while cash flow fell from the 2020 peak. Owner-FCF margin history: FY2019 16%, FY2021 24% (prior peak), FY2022 10%, FY2024 13%, FY2025 11%, TTM Q3-2026 17.8% (after a ~220 working-capital build).

base.rationale: Growth: FY2027 +2% (Q4-2026 guide is flat sequentially at ~1.3B/quarter; SoC already fell from 882 in Q1 to 677 in Q3 while memory/HBM rose), FY2028 -8% digestion year, then recovery to a ~5% mid-cycle rate. FY2036 revenue ~7.4B. Margin: adjusted (pre-SBC) EBITDA was ~37.5% in 9M-2026 at a 5.2B run-rate, 37% in FY2021 and 26% in FY2025; 33.5% long-run sits between the mid-cycle and peak readings on a permanently larger revenue base. SBC incl. award taxes held near 2.5% (mature issuer, no credible decline). D&A rises toward capex as the recent 6-7%-of-revenue capex years depreciate. Capex 5.5% easing to 5.0% (FY2017-2020 averaged ~5%, FY2023-2025 6-7%). Cash tax 16% (9M-2026 ETR 14.4%, FY2025 cash taxes 18% of pretax; Singapore holiday runs to 2035, Pillar Two floor 15%), stepped to 18% in the final two years so the perpetuity does not capitalise the holiday. Working capital NEGATIVE capture: receivables + inventory far exceed payables, so growth consumes cash (9M-2026 build ~220 on ~1.6B of incremental revenue) and a revenue decline releases it. Cap 15x as a cyclical.

bull.rationale: No digestion year: FY2026 is a new floor and revenue doubles again to ~10.5B by FY2036 (12.7% CAGR off FY2025). Margins hold at and slightly above the 9M-2026 peak level for a decade.

bear.rationale: A normal semicap bust: revenue falls ~33% over two years to ~3.5B (still above FY2025's 3.19B), in line with the FY2021->FY2023 peak-to-trough of -28%, then grows at mid-single digits to ~4.8B by FY2036 (3.9% CAGR off FY2025). Margins revert to the FY2022-FY2025 range (26-31% adjusted) on a larger cost base. The working-capital release in the two down years flatters early FCF, as it did in prior downturns.

scenario_narratives.base: The AI/HBM test surge is partly structural and partly a pull-forward. Test intensity per device really has stepped up (custom hyperscaler ASICs, HBM stacks, advanced packaging), so revenue does not return to the 3B level, but the 2026 run-rate also contains capacity builds by a handful of VIP compute customers that pause once installed. Revenue holds near 5.3B in FY2027, dips ~8% in a FY2028 digestion year, then grows at 5-8% fading to 3%, reaching ~7.4B in FY2036. Teradyne keeps its duopoly seat but Advantest retains the lead in merchant GPU test, so Teradyne's growth tracks the market rather than beating it. Adjusted EBITDA margin normalises from ~37.5% to 33.5%; Robotics stays around break-even to modestly profitable and is not a value driver.
scenario_narratives.bull: AI compute and HBM test demand keeps compounding without a digestion year: hyperscaler custom-silicon programmes broaden beyond today's few customers, Magnum takes further HBM/DRAM final-test share, and the MultiLane, Quantifi Photonics and FormFactor moves open silicon-photonics and high-speed interconnect test as a real third leg. Revenue grows 15% and 12% in FY2027-28 and reaches ~10.5B by FY2036. Margins stay at the 2026 peak level (38-39% adjusted) because the duopoly holds price, and Robotics becomes solidly profitable on the OEM/integrator channel.
scenario_narratives.bear: The classic semicap overshoot. One or two of the concentrated VIP compute customers (top five were 44% of FY2025 revenue, one alone ~19%) finish their build-outs or shift programmes to Advantest, HBM capacity additions pause, and tighter China export controls remove part of the 14-21% of revenue sold there. Revenue falls about a third over two years to ~3.5B, as in FY2021-FY2023, and recovers only at trend. Margins fall back to the FY2022-FY2025 range on a now-larger R&D base, and Robotics slips back to losses against low-cost Asian cobot competition.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 house default to 25/50/25. Bear raised to 25% because the valuation starts from a cyclical peak year in an industry that has overshot in every prior cycle, with single-customer (~19%) and top-five (44%) concentration and live export-control exposure. Base stays at 50%: partial retention of the step-up is the central reading of rising test intensity. Bull cut to 25% because it needs several independent things at once - no AI capex digestion for a decade, share held against Advantest in the fastest-growing pool, peak margins sustained, and a Robotics turnaround that has one profitable quarter behind it.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Teradyne is valued as a cyclical duopolist at a mid-cycle earnings power above its history but below the 2026 run-rate. The 2026 surge is used as the starting revenue base (it is real, and partly structural) but not as a growth rate: every scenario fades to 3-3.5% growth, the base case includes a digestion year, margins normalise below the 9M-2026 peak, and the terminal multiple is capped at 15x. Risk is charged once, through the scenario paths and a 25% bear weight, with a single 10% WACC. On that framing the current price requires something close to or beyond the bull case, i.e. the market is capitalising the 2026 run-rate as a floor with continued double-digit growth.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle position: if FY2026 proves a durable floor with continued double-digit growth (the bull path), the base case understates value by roughly half; if it is an ordinary peak, even the base case is generous.
Customer concentration: one customer ~19% and the top five 44% of FY2025 revenue; a single programme moving to Advantest shifts the path between scenarios.

Margin normalisation level: each 1pp of long-run adjusted EBITDA margin is worth roughly 3-4% of base value; the 33.5% base assumption sits between the FY2025 trough-ish 26% and the 9M-2026 peak of ~37.5%.
China export controls on 14-21% of quarterly revenue.
Tax: the Singapore holiday (to 2035) and the Pillar Two safe harbour hold the cash rate near 16%; loss of either moves it toward 21%.
Capital allocation: $300M FormFactor stake, MultiLane JV and Quantifi Photonics are treated as value-neutral at cost; Robotics' cumulative acquisition spend has not earned its cost of capital.
